text:
incident-bot: PAGING: token-queue backpressure observed in prod inference pool (us-west-2). p95 latency rising >2s and token_queue_length > 18k on inference-gpu-pool-42. Auto-scale failed to add nodes. Triggering page to oncall.

Carla (oncall): ack. looking now, grabbing logs and queue metrics.

Devon: seeing repeated KV cache eviction spikes and OOM throttles from 3 hosts (gpu-42/43/44). network egress to object-store also spiking. attaching quick grep: `ERROR kvcache: evict failed: oom` x 42 entries in last 5m.

Carla (oncall): will temporarily reduce global batch_size from 8 -> 4 on the affected model group to relieve memory pressure. Patching now: `reconfig set model.runtime.batch_size=4 --selector pool=us-west-2-gpu`

Ben: +1 to batch reduction. also starting preemptive routing to dedicated-cpu-pool for small requests to free GPU slots: `route policy add fallback=cpu-small when queue_len>5000`

Devon: rolling restart kube daemonset on gpu-42/43 to recover stuck processes. `kubectl rollout restart ds/inference-runtime -n prod --selector node=gpu-42` Doing one at a time.

Maya (comms): drafting status page and customer note. Impact: "Elevated generation latency and intermittent failed requests for customers using large-sequence generation in us-west-2. Other regions unaffected." ETA on mitigations?

Carla (oncall): batch change + routing fallback applied. initial drop in queue length from 18k -> 7.6k in ~4m. p95 latency lowered from ~2.1s -> 1.1s. Still seeing retry spikes; continuing restarts. ETA 30m to stabilize, 60m for full recovery.

Sam (ops-lead): good progress. please capture exact commands and timestamps for postmortem. set incident severity to Sev2 and notify CS for customers with active large-context jobs.

Priya (customer-liaison): flagged 3 customers on watch (alpha-media, docsprint, legal-qa). drafting proactive note: `We are experiencing higher-than-normal latency for large-generation workloads in us-west-2. We have applied mitigations (batch size reduction, routing fallback, targeted restarts) and expect service to stabilize within ~30-60 minutes. No action required; we will follow up when fully recovered.` Share any timeline updates here and I will escalate.

Ben: enabling additional autoscale policy to allow burst nodes for gpu pools `autoscale policy update --min 10 --max 40 --burst 8 --selector pool=us-west-2-gpu` (will allow quicker node adds). also turning on temporarily relaxed placement constraints.

Devon: restarted gpu-43 successfully; saw one pod crash loop due to leftover mmap. killed residue, pod relaunched cleanly. queue down to 2.1k. p95 ~720ms.

Carla (oncall): rolling restarts complete. routing fallback still active. monitoring for 15m. marking mitigation phase "in progress".

Maya (comms): status page draft below — please confirm copy: 
```
Incident detected: Increased generation latency and request failures for large-sequence workloads in us-west-2.
Status: Mitigations in progress (batch-size reduction, routing fallback to CPU pool, targeted restarts). Partial recovery observed.
Customer impact: Intermittent elevated latency and some failed requests for large-context jobs. Not all customers affected.
Estimated recovery: 30-60 minutes for stabilization; full recovery expected within 1 hour.
Updates: We will post another update in 20 minutes and a resolution note after recovery.
```

Carla (oncall): looks accurate. add note: "No data exfiltration or security issue identified."

Priya (customer-liaison): customer message ready to send to alpha-media and docsprint with minor tailoring. will hold until next update confirms stabilization. :thumbsup:

Ben: monitoring infra scaling. no further autoscale errors. preparing to disable routing fallback once queue <300 and p95 <500ms for 10m.

Devon: logs show one noisy client that was sending repeated long-context requests (windowed retries). throttled that client at edge for 10m: `ratelimit client=cli-9876 requests_per_min=30`

Maya (comms): added PS-incident tag and created incident page draft in the status portal. copying customer notification template here for records: "We detected elevated latency impacting large-generation requests in us-west-2. Our engineers applied mitigations and the service is stabilizing. We expect full recovery within one hour. We apologize for the inconvenience and will follow up when resolved."

Carla (oncall): marking as partially mitigated. continuing to observe. if stable for 20m, will start handoff to night oncall.

Sam (ops-lead): please prepare postmortem timeline and include: initial detection, metric spikes, commands applied, autoscale failure reason (investigate cloud provider logs), and remediation steps. assign owner for root cause.

Devon: also adding note: evaluate KV cache sizing defaults and eviction thresholds; potential for model config to request excessive KV memory for certain prompt patterns.

Carla (oncall): update — stable for 22m, p95 420ms, queue 120. filing brief incident summary and handing to Night oncall. Night oncall: @Carla handing off; see thread for full timeline.

Maya (comms): sending customer messages now to flagged accounts and posting interim status page update. will post final resolution when verified.

Priya (customer-liaison): messages sent. customers acknowledged — no SLA credits requested yet, they appreciate the proactive updates.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation successful, service stabilized. Remember to run postmortem template: `incident postmortem create --id 3654326789`.

Carla (oncall): closing active page. will attach logs and commands to the postmortem and follow up on root cause tomorrow. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
